sources.notes: CC-BY-4.0 parent article; 152740 bytes,1328 rows,Windows-1252 text. SHA256 e559a0e6759044c6a969dab53c56a843e3c1d8d957fbb3881b78488774dfb687. MANC DNa04/DNa05 map to DNut001/DNut002 with published matching confidence3/5; DNp07/DNp10 map to DNxn027/DNxl018 with confidence5/5. Male VNC body IDs are not female FlyWire630 root IDs; conflicting historical brain type correspondence remains unresolved.

sources.title: State-dependent decoupling of sensory and motor circuits underlies behavioral flexibility in Drosophila
sources.notes: Published Nature Neuroscience 2019, DOI 10.1038/s41593-019-0413-4. Accessible primary results/methods reviewed: DNp07/DNp10 causally drive landing leg extension with state-dependent visual gating. DNp07 but not DNp10 is gated by octopamine. Tethered leg responses do not establish a complete physical touchdown controller.

sources.title: Organization of circuits linking descending input to motor output in the Drosophila Male Adult Nerve Cord connectome
sources.notes: Published eLife record DOI 10.7554/eLife.96084, accessible primary wing-circuit sections reviewed. DNa04/DNa05 steering candidates target w-cHIN premotor paths; electrical connectivity inferred from close membrane contact is putative, not measured conductance. MANC male specimen is not interchangeable with female FlyWire630 IDs.

sources.title: A population of descending neurons that regulates the flight motor of Drosophila
sources.notes: Verified final Current Biology 2022 publication DOI 10.1016/j.cub.2022.01.008; primary DNg02 population/amplitude results reviewed. Supersedes describing only the 2021 preprint; does not supply a full flight-navigation decoder.

sources.title: The role of a population of descending neurons in the optomotor response in flying Drosophila
sources.notes: Caltech submitted/preprint record. Unilateral DNg02 activation produces bilateral wing-amplitude increases rather than the expected asymmetric optomotor steering; additional descending/motor circuitry is needed.
